source: docs/research/android-platform.md §3.8, §7 (Universal Android Debloater NG levels, uad_lists.json of 2026-11-15). Presence on a given device must be checked: an absent package is ignored.
notes: profile: balanced = balanced (Play Services, Play Store, FCM push and banking apps untouched); strict = added to the balanced profile. method: hide = setApplicationHidden (the app disappears, its services stop), suspend = setPackagesSuspended (greyed-out icon, activities blocked; its background services may continue). default: checked by default in the profile. Packages on the hard-coded deny list (PackageDenyList) are refused even if they appear here.

restrictions.title: Forbid adding users
restrictions.description: Prevents creating a secondary user or a guest. A non-affiliated user would make the network and security logs and the enforced private DNS fail.
restrictions.breaks: Guest mode and additional users impossible.

restrictions.title: Forbid 2G
restrictions.description: The modem no longer uses 2G, which is vulnerable to fake base stations (IMSI catchers) and weak encryption. Emergency calls remain possible.
restrictions.breaks: No network where only 2G exists (rural areas, some connected objects).

restrictions.title: Forbid unknown sources
restrictions.description: No app (browser, file manager…) can install APKs. The Play Store and the Galaxy Store remain usable; installation through ADB (Watchpost updates) is not affected according to the documentation (to be verified).
restrictions.breaks: F-Droid, Aurora and installing downloaded APKs.

restrictions.title: Turn off content capture
restrictions.description: The system no longer passes the displayed content to the content capture service (system AI features).
restrictions.breaks: Some contextual suggestions of the system.

restrictions.title: Turn off content suggestions
restrictions.description: The system no longer sends screenshots or excerpts to the content suggestions service.
restrictions.breaks: Suggestions on screenshots and smart text selection.

restrictions.title: Block adding certificates
restrictions.description: Prevents installing a user certificate authority (the classic vector of TLS interception) and changing the credential storage.
restrictions.breaks: Enterprise Wi-Fi (EAP-TLS) and certificate VPNs, which must be configured beforehand.

restrictions.title: Forbid safe mode
restrictions.description: Safe mode starts without third-party apps, therefore without Watchpost.
restrictions.breaks: Loss of a recourse in case a malicious app locks the phone.

restrictions.title: Turn off content sent to the assistant
restrictions.description: The assistant (Google, Gemini, Bixby) no longer receives the screen content.
restrictions.breaks: Circle to Search and "What's on screen".

restrictions.title: Block eSIM downloads
restrictions.description: Prevents adding an eSIM (downloaded carrier profile).

restrictions.title: Turn off ultra-wideband (UWB)
restrictions.description: Turns off the UWB radio, which allows precise short-range location of the device.
restrictions.breaks: Precise finding of SmartTags, digital car keys.

restrictions.title: Turn off Thread
restrictions.description: Turns off the Thread radio (Matter home automation), if the device has one.
restrictions.breaks: Thread home automation from the phone.

restrictions.title: Forbid USB file transfer
restrictions.description: Turns off file transfer (MTP/PTP) over the cable. ADB and charging are not affected.
restrictions.breaks: Copying photos and files over the cable.

restrictions.title: Turn off NFC
restrictions.breaks: Contactless payment (Google Wallet, Samsung Wallet, transit cards).

settings.title: Permanent Bluetooth scanning
settings.description: When Bluetooth is off, the system by default keeps scanning for nearby Bluetooth beacons for location. This setting stops that scanning. Requires WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS granted through ADB (grant-adb-permissions script).
settings.breaks: Less precise indoor location; some detections of nearby objects when Bluetooth is off.
